title: Genetic and evolutionary learning
summary: The scalar GA treats each generation as a replayable machine event; dev5 adds a separate Pareto-ranked GA that reuses the same deterministic historical machinery without scalarizing independent objectives.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Population and deterministic RNG state are restored together.
MLGeneticAlgorithm.step evaluates the current population and breeds the replacement; the new population is explicitly unevaluated.
MLGeneticAlgorithm.run performs breeding steps and then evaluates/publishes the final bred population.
Candidate budgets are planned in evaluated populations, not merely breeding calls.
Same checkpoint + same code/policy reproduces the same generation; changing policy creates a deliberate alternate future.
Pareto-ranked evolution is a separate objective-vector path; do not force it through scalar fitness or claim full NSGA-II conformance.
procedure: Create a named MLGeneticPolicy and MLGABudgetPlan.
Commit RNG cursor and next population only after the generation succeeds.
For a complete search call run(), so the terminal offspring population is evaluated and published.
Retain evaluated-generation evidence and all alternate futures.

provenance.claim: Pareto-ranked deterministic GA reuses population/RNG/experiment state and complete final-generation evaluation.
Corrected complete-run semantics, named policy and bounded evaluated-generation budget.
Regression proves final bred population is scored before complete run returns.
